svg.text: each cell: the 4 shard-slots on one GPU · brightness = how many of the 4 terms are accumulated
column position → shard index (same order in every box):
every rank holds its own full gradient, 4 shards × S/4
colored arrow = the shard it carries · same-numbered slot lights up (+) on arrival
same rule, one hop further · partial sums keep travelling clockwise
last hop completes the sum · each rank now owns ONE fully-summed shard (Σ)
3 more hops per link, pure data movement (no more +) · every rank ends with all 4 Σ shards
